note: Free-placed objects, same scale as the farmer and nature objects. Anchor = bottom center of each sprite (x + w/2, y + h). Draw sorted by anchor y with the farmer. 'collision' = suggested blocking box [w,h] at the bottom center (null = walk-through). Fence pieces share one baseline, place them side by side by anchor so the rails meet. gate_open is walkable, gate_closed blocks.

farmhouse.interaction: door at bottom center: walk to it to enter / sleep

seed_stall.interaction: stand in front of the counter (bottom center) to buy seeds

well.interaction: stand next to it to refill the watering can

shipping_bin.interaction: stand next to it to ship crops
shipping_bin.note: filled version; swap with shipping_bin_empty. Both bottoms sit on the same baseline (anchor bottom-center).

shipping_bin_empty.interaction: same as shipping_bin; default look when nothing is inside

banner_unrestored.interaction: Interact (Space/click) to see progress toward the 500G goal.

banner_restored.interaction: Shown after total earnings reach 500G and the day ends. Same size and baseline as banner_unrestored.
